methods.description: Bound a non-square positive number using consecutive perfect squares.
Bound a non-cube positive number using consecutive perfect cubes.
Recognise a perfect square or cube and give an exact root.
Refine a rough estimate and verify a nearest-whole answer with a simple squared/cubed halfway value.
Estimate and plot approximate root positions; check with a calculator and use approximation notation.
Verify proposed positive bounds by squaring them, including decimal bounds.
Compare roots using disjoint bounds or ordered radicands of the same root type.
Reverse positive root bounds using squares/cubes and count allowable whole numbers.
